## The case against paying 123.45

The record's own five-year rating (`pe_ratio_5y_average` 22.1x against `pe_ratio_current` 18.4x) looks cheap only if the profit line holds. Net income grew from 200.5 to 225.5 million dollars year over year, but the order backlog passage warns of two large cancellations. If the backlog note is the leading indicator, the guided 6,100 million dollars of revenue (`guidance_revenue_fy`) is the number to distrust.

The shares sit at 123.45 against a 52-week range of 80.10 to 150.20: the market has already paid for most of the recovery. A miss at the 2026-10-22 results date reopens the 80s.
